slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: Regional report on the October 2016 APAI-CRVS monitoring round: Seychelles is listed among the 15 countries that did not fill in the form, so no digitisation answer is given for it; its only other mention is as one of four countries with compulsory, universal registration meeting international standards, which says nothing of how an office makes the record.
